name: std::ranges::adjacent_view<V,N>::end

declarations.code:
constexpr auto end() const
    requires ranges::range<const V>;

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator to the element following the last element, if the underlying view V models common_range. Otherwise, a sentinel which compares equal to the end iterator.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: ranges::adjacent_view<V,N> models common_range whenever the underlying view V does.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a adjacent_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.

summary: Returns an iterator or a sentinel representing the end of the adjacent_view.
